key.skirmish.player_menu.open: Menu for the player under the crosshair
skirmish.module.player_menu.name: Player Menu
skirmish.module.player_menu.description: A key on the player under the crosshair (or a pick from the tab list) opens a menu: copy the nick, put /ah player, /pay, /msg, /clan invite into the chat box, add a friend, dossier. Commands are never sent by themselves: you press Enter.
Open the menu for the player under the crosshair (never invisible players, never through blocks)
skirmish.module.player_menu.setting.auct: «/ah player Nick»: the player's auction lots
skirmish.module.player_menu.setting.pick: When nobody is under the crosshair, open a searchable list of online players
skirmish.player_menu.hint: The command opens in chat: send it with Enter. Keys 1–9 pick a row.
skirmish.player_menu.pick_hint: Online players from the tab list
